		arg := args[i]

		case "-V", "--version":

			for _, line := range lines {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line != "" {
					conf.URIs = append(conf.URIs, line)
				}
			}
		case "-w", "--wordlist":
			i++
			conf.Wordlist = args[i]
		case "-x", "--extensions":
			i++
			exts := strings.Split(args[i], ",")
			conf.Extensions = append(conf.Extensions, exts...)
		case "-p", "--prefixes":
			i++
			prefs := strings.Split(args[i], ",")
			conf.Prefixes = append(conf.Prefixes, prefs...)
		case "-f", "--force-extension":
			conf.ForceExtension = true
		case "--ext-sub":

			i++
			conf.OutputFile = args[i]
		case "-v":
			conf.Verbose++
		case "-vv":
			conf.Verbose += 2
		case "--verbose":
			conf.Verbose++
		case "-S", "--silent":
			conf.Silent = true
		case "-r", "--disable-recursion":
			conf.DisableRecursion = true
		case "--max-recursion-depth":
			i++
			conf.MaxRecursionDepth, _ = strconv.Atoi(args[i])
		case "-l", "--scan-listable":
			conf.ScanListable = true
		case "--scrape-listable":
			conf.ScrapeListable = true
		case "--no-color":
			conf.NoColor = true
		case "-B", "--code-blacklist":
			i++
			codes := strings.Split(args[i], ",")
			for _, c := range codes {
				ci, _ := strconv.Atoi(c)
				conf.CodeBlacklist = append(conf.CodeBlacklist, ci)
			}
		case "-W", "--code-whitelist":
			i++
			codes := strings.Split(args[i], ",")
			for _, c := range codes {
				ci, _ := strconv.Atoi(c)
				conf.CodeWhitelist = append(conf.CodeWhitelist, ci)
			}
		case "-a", "--user-agent":
			i++
			conf.UserAgent = args[i]
		case "-c", "--cookie":
			i++
			conf.Cookies = append(conf.Cookies, args[i])
		case "-H", "--header":
			i++
			conf.Headers = append(conf.Headers, args[i])
		case "--verb":
			i++
			conf.Verb = strings.ToUpper(args[i])
		default:
			if !strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
				conf.URIs = append(conf.URIs, arg)
			}
		}
	}

	if conf.Wordlist == "" {
		exe, _ := os.Executable()
		conf.Wordlist = strings.TrimSuffix(exe, "executable") + "dirble_wordlist.txt"
	}

	return conf
